name: Icarus Narrative
axiom: Warn by showing the ascent that felt right, then the boundary it crossed.
trigger: Technical-debt reviews, growth retrospectives, and any warning where the audience is proud of the thing being criticised.

steps.text: Premature optimism: the shortcut that looked like speed.
Rapid ascent: the results that made it look wise.
Boundary breach: the assumption that was never true.
Rapid descent: the cost, arriving faster than the gain did.

antiPattern.violation: Delivering the warning from the ground, so the audience hears a lecture instead of recognising their own ascent.
antiPattern.remediation: Let the rise be genuinely attractive before the fall. The warning lands when the audience remembers choosing it.

prompt: The boundary we are not checking is ______.
